About

Reaching, teaching, restoring and equipping God’s people

Johnell Haynes III is an ordained pastor, author, and leader with a deep passion for serving God’s people and helping them overcome life’s obstacles so they can walk confidently in their God-given purpose and destiny.

He is committed to unlocking the hearts and minds of believers through the teaching of God’s Word, writing, and creative ministry. With a heart for restoring families and strengthening covenant relationships, Pastor Johnell carries a special burden to see healthy marriages and thriving homes established within the Body of Christ.

Together with his wife, Apostle Dr. Monique Haynes, he serves as Senior Pastor of VeriSource Hub Raleigh under the leadership of Apostle Dr. Angela Thibeaux. Previously, they founded The Rock Life Center, where they faithfully served and pastored their congregation before transitioning into the VeriSource Global family.

Pastor Johnell carries a strong anointing in biblical counseling, healing, discipleship, and worship. His ministry is marked by compassion, wisdom, and a desire to lead people into deeper intimacy with God and lasting spiritual transformation.

He is the author of I’ve Been Diagnosed… Now What? Contending for My Faith, a powerful testimony of faith, perseverance, and trusting God through life’s challenges. Through his life and ministry, Pastor Johnell remains committed to reaching, teaching, restoring, and equipping individuals and families to live out their Kingdom assignment with faith and purpose.

Ministry

How he serves

Pastor Johnell serves individuals, couples, and families in four ways.

Biblical Counseling

Wise, compassionate guidance for couples, parents and individuals walking through hard seasons.

Healing

Grounding believers in the Word so faith becomes a firm foundation for every area of life.

Worship

Leading people into deeper intimacy with God through worship and creative ministry.

New book

The Merge

When Family and Faith Converge

In a world that pulls families in every direction, faith and family can collide. The Merge is a practical guide to aligning what matters most: God, your family, and your legacy. Johnell shares real-life wisdom, biblical truth, and strategies to navigate hardship with unshakeable faith and hold strong when nothing can break what God has built.

  • How to build a faith-filled foundation that strengthens your home
  • Practical principles for godly parenting and purposeful leadership
  • Strategies to navigate life’s storms with unity and hope
  • The power of prayer, covenant, and legacy to transform generations
